scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && node scripts/check-test-services.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,web "PORT=${PORT:-4000} DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://mapchat_test:mapchat_test@127.0.0.1:55431/mapchat_foundation_test} REDIS_URL=${REDIS_URL:-redis://127.0.0.1:56381} READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS=${READINESS_TIMEOUT_MS:-1000} pnpm --filter @map-chat/api dev" "DEV_API_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:${PORT:-4000} WEB_PORT=${WEB_PORT:-3000} pnpm --filter @map-chat/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @map-chat/web typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @map-chat/contracts build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/api build && pnpm --filter @map-chat/web build
